title: NBA: 'Remarkable' rookie Lendeborg scores 37 as Warriors beat Clippers
summary: Rookie Yaxel Lendeborg poured in 37 points as the Golden State Warriors shrugged off the absence of Stephen Curry to beat the Los Angeles Clippers 124-112 on Sunday.
